problem: Existing application/debug/audit logs and media appeared unavailable; snapshots appeared partial with no visible scanned amount.

cause.path_failure: Go Getwd accepts an equivalent shell PWD alias; filepath.Abs therefore retained /var for relative log paths. Media already used /var in deployment config. The descriptor-based collector rejected the symlink ancestor. Earlier read-only acceptance used only canonical cwd and missed this runtime form.
cause.snapshot_failure: Fixed per-source entry/time fractions discarded unused budget from small sources, cutting off the later 10018-file snapshot directory even while the global budget had capacity.

fix.registration: Resolve existing targets in trusted deployment configuration once at startup, including existing ancestors of not-yet-created directories. Bind source IDs/paths and ordinary-log lifecycle to the same canonical root. No directory creation, no caller-controlled paths.
fix.boundaries: After binding, descriptor-based no-follow and per-item mutation checks remain. Nested symlinks and later symlink replacement are refused. Inaccessible or invalid roots stay unavailable without preventing business startup.
fix.scan_budget: Remaining entry/time budget divided over remaining sources; unchanged global default ceiling of 20000 entries and two seconds. No background rescan, unbounded scan or page polling.
fix.partial_display: Show known scanned bytes with incomplete/not-deduplicated label. Never publish partial bytes as complete attributed usage or add them to a complete total. Absent values remain unknown.

local_readonly_acceptance.boundary: In-process service with actual local configuration and files/database; no worker/listener, draft write, capture, cleanup or migration. Existing user Core has not loaded this code until user restarts.

checks: aliased shell PWD and absolute media path
source binding does not follow later alias retargeting
later source uses remaining scan budget

browser.boundary: Isolated actual Nuxt artifact and controlled API fixtures. Partial/missing explanations, confirmed manual log flow, history, context and no idle requests tested. Not live user-Core HTTP acceptance.

validation.contract: OpenAPI 0.4.1; unchanged DTO shape, clarified problem codes and partial-byte semantics; 266 storageGov leaves match across four locales.

remaining: User restarts Core with original command and refreshes Web Admin for installed-runtime acceptance. No new migration needed.
Scans exceeding the global limit remain partial; displaying scanned bytes is not a resumable background collector.
Previous whole-PowerX coverage, other lifecycle adapters and unified automatic-governance tasks remain open.
